## 👷 Worker Management System

### New Features
- **3 Worker Types**: Farm Hands (+25% yield), Miners (+20% income), Property Managers (-30% repairs)
- **Skills & Training**: 5 trainable skills (Harvesting, Mining, Maintenance, Efficiency, Speed) - Levels 1-10
- **Loyalty System**: 0-100 scale, workers quit if loyalty falls below 20
- **Economics**: $5K hiring, $100-500/day salaries, $1K training per session
- **Management GUI**: 5 view modes (Overview, Hire, Manage, Training, Assignments)

### Commands
- \/workers\ - Open worker management GUI
- \/worker hire <type> <name>\ - Hire a new worker
- \/worker fire <name>\ - Fire a worker
- \/worker assign <name> <target>\ - Assign worker to farm/mine/property
- \/worker list\ - List all your workers
- \/worker stats <name>\ - View worker details

### Integration
- ✅ 25% farm efficiency boost with Farm Hands
- ✅ 20% mine income bonus with Miners

- ✅ Daily salary payments
- ✅ Weekly loyalty updates

releases.notes:
## 🎉 MASSIVE UPDATE - v1.0.47

### 🐛 CRITICAL BUG FIXES

**Loan System Rebalanced**
- Fixed ridiculous 5.5x repayment → now max 1.5x total
- Interest rates now mean TOTAL loan interest, not daily compound
- Excellent credit (100): 20% total interest
- Poor credit (20): 50% total interest
- Much more reasonable for players!

**Property Rental Fixed**
- Middle-click rent no longer triggers auction house
- Fixed action propagation bug

**Mines More Affordable**
- Reduced all mining operation costs by 50%
- Much faster ROI on mining investments

**Teleport Commands**
- Changed /teleport to /tele and /warp
- No more vanilla command conflicts

---

### 🆕 NEW: TENANT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM ⭐

**Complete Rental Management**
- Track all rented properties in one place
- See tenant names, relationships, rent amounts
- Adjust rent prices (±10% per click)
- Evict problematic tenants

**Random Tenant Events**
- 🎁 **Gifts**: Tenants give money or items (+relationship)
- 💥 **Damage**: Property damage requires repairs (-money, -relationship)
- 💰 **Rent Changes**: Tenants may request reductions

**Relationship System**
- 0-100 relationship score per tenant
- High relationships = fewer problems, more gifts
- Low relationships = more damage, complaints
- Eviction penalties based on relationship

**New Commands:**
- /tenant - Open tenant management GUI
- Fully integrated into Hub menu

---

### 🗺️ NEW: TELEPORT ENHANCEMENTS ⭐

**Home System**
- /sethome - Set your personal home location
- /home - Teleport to your home instantly

**Coordinate Teleportation**
- /tele <x> <y> <z> - Teleport to exact coordinates
- Great for precise navigation
- No OP required!

**Waypoint Management**
- Save custom locations with names
- Manage all waypoints in GUI
- Quick teleport to saved spots

---

### 🌾 NEW: FARMING QOL FEATURES ⭐

**Harvest All**
- One button collects from ALL farms
- Automatic selling of harvested items
- Shows total earnings

**Auto-Sell Toggle**
- Enable auto-sell for fully AFK farming
- Automatically sells all harvested items
- Track total earnings

**Fertilizer System**
- Spend ,000 to boost next harvest by 50%
- Stack bonuses across multiple farms
- Great for maximizing profits

**Farm Statistics**
- Total items harvested (lifetime)
- Total money earned
- Active farm count
- Track your farming empire!

---

### 📊 BALANCE CHANGES

**Loans:**
- 30-day loan at excellent credit: 1.2x total repayment (was 5.5x)
- 30-day loan at poor credit: 1.5x total repayment (was 5.5x)
- Daily payments now reasonable

**Mining:**
- All operation costs reduced by 50%
- Same daily income
- ROI improved dramatically

**Farming:**
- Already 3x more productive than before
- New QOL features make it even better

---

### 🎮 NEW COMMANDS ADDED

- /tenant - Manage rental properties and tenants
- /tele <x> <y> <z> - Teleport to coordinates
- /warp - Alternative to /tele
- /home - Teleport to home location
- /sethome - Set home location

---

### 📦 FILES ADDED/MODIFIED

**New Files (4):**
- TenantManager.java - Tenant system backend
- TenantGui.java - Full tenant interface
- TenantCommand.java - Command registration
- WaypointManager.java - Waypoint storage

**Modified Files (9):**
- LoanManager.java - Interest calculation fix
- PropertyGui.java - Middle-click fix
- MiningManager.java - Cost reduction
- TeleportCommand.java - Command changes
- TeleportGui.java - Waypoint features
- FarmGui.java - New QOL features
- FarmManager.java - Auto-sell, stats
- HubGui.java - Tenant button
- ShopMod.java - Command registration

---

### 🚀 Installation

1. Download shop-1.0.47.jar
2. Remove old versions from mods folder
3. Place new jar in .minecraft/mods folder
4. Requires Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ and Minecraft 1.21.11

---

### 💡 Quick Start

**Try the new features:**
1. /tenant - See your rental properties
2. /sethome - Set a home location
3. Open Farms GUI - Try the Harvest All button!
4. Take a loan - See reasonable interest rates!
